description: How a set from make_image_ads is going: queued, in_progress, ready with each image ad's headline, second line and button, in headline, subhead and cta, and its download_url, or failed with why and whether its credits were refunded. Each image ad's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_image_ads again for a new link. Free.
